THE LAND

1,308 sqm of beachfront, from the road to the water

The plot sits on the coastline between Hin Kong and Srithanu, on the west side of Koh Phangan - the sunset side. It slopes down from the upper road to the beach, about 100 m long. The upper frontage is narrow (about 11 m) and the sea frontage is wider (about 15.6 m). One old house stands on the plot today.

  • Chanote - full freehold title deed in Thailand.
  • No external debt - the company holding the land has no mortgage and no bank lien.
  • Sloping to the sea - open sea views across the plot, and direct beach access from the lower end.

THE PROPOSED SPLIT

The project is planned in three parts

Today the land is one plot under one title deed. The project is planned in three parts, and if you want only Plot 1, or Plots 1 + 2, that is possible: we split the land into three and allocate the area you choose to you.

The split has not been made yet. It is registered only if you choose a partial package, as part of the deal.
  • Plot 1 - on the beach. The spot for Villa 1, first line to the sea.
  • Plot 2 - the middle. Shared areas: garden, pergola, access road.
  • Plot 3 - on the hill. The spot for Villa 3.
